source.note: This sidecar does not reproduce the source rules text. It records neutral prototype semantics needed to test DODGE gaps.

migration_intent.purpose: Preserve suspected neutral contracts for RPG-shaped semantics that DIRPS may need while targeting DODGE 0.2.1.
migration_intent.rule: At G0 these are hypotheses, not DODGE gaps proven by execution. DIRPS must first pass the selected DODGE version and exercise a concept through shared validation/resolution/runtime before promotion.
migration_intent.target: future DODGE proposal only after candidate evidence exists
promotion_gate: implemented through shared resolver/runtime rather than target-specific code
covered by positive, negative, and perturbation/deterministic tests as applicable
demonstrated to be reusable beyond GURPS-specific terminology
migration_intent.g5_note: G5 exercises only the minimum concepts required by the bounded attempt-skill -> success-roll path. Exercise does not imply DODGE candidacy. The binary <= classifier is explicitly bounded to effective targets 4..16; targets outside that domain fail visibly rather than approximating GURPS edge semantics. Session history, derived values/modifiers, critical-result consequences, and broader RPG semantics remain suspected/unimplemented.
migration_intent.phase_a_note: Phase A executes source-owned contextual modifiers, derives effective target as base skill plus the declared modifier total, classifies GURPS Lite critical success/failure boundaries, and supports deterministic generated 3d6 evidence. derived_values and expressions were reassessed but remain suspected because Phase A uses a bounded DIRPS-private execution binding rather than either proposed generic proto shape.

dice_resolution.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 has randomizer objects but no first-class executable roll/resolution primitive that records rolled terms and a deterministic outcome.
dice_resolution.g5_evidence: G5 executes the proposed 3d6 dice-pool/lte success-roll contract from the resolved sidecar using supplied deterministic die terms.
dice_resolution.phase_a_evidence: Phase A adds deterministic generated evidence using the runtime-owned sha256-rejection-v1 algorithm while preserving seed, algorithm id, individual die terms, and total. Supplied explicit die terms remain supported.

derived_values.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 value definitions store typed state but do not define dependency formulas for derived values.
derived_values.phase_a_evidence: Reassessed but not promoted: Phase A computes one effective target inside the bounded attempt-skill execution binding. It does not implement the proposed generic derived-value contract, dependency graph, or recomputation model.

expressions.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 conditions/effects provide bounded operators but not a reusable arithmetic expression graph for rules math.

lookup_tables.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 has no first-class table lookup semantic for rules that map one value/range to another result.

procedure_context.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 ordered procedures lack named local variables/outputs that later steps can reference.
dirps_evidence: base target -> modifiers -> effective target -> roll -> margin -> consequence
procedure_context.g5_evidence: G5 requires named actor/skill/random-evidence inputs and emits named target/result outputs for success-roll; this remains a DIRPS-private runtime shape.
procedure_context.phase_a_evidence: Phase A adds context_ref plus resolved modifier inputs and exposes base target, modifier total, effective target, critical classification, and random-evidence provenance.

reaction_timing.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 phases and ordered procedures do not explicitly model interrupt/reaction windows or constrained defensive responses.
dirps_evidence: active defenses after a successful attack

visibility_and_secret_state.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 has no generic visibility contract for GM-only state, hidden checks, or player-visible versus concealed information.

actor_character_model.dodge_gap: DODGE actors can be objects with state, but RPG character structure is currently ad hoc instance state/extensions.
actor_character_model.g5_evidence: G5 runtime selects the resolved actor and reads its resolved character skill bindings; no generic DODGE character model is claimed.

skill_model.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 has no reusable semantic model for learned skills, defaults, governing attributes, or resolved levels.
skill_model.g5_evidence: G5 executes one explicitly resolved skill level as the target; governing attributes, defaults, and a full generic skill model remain unimplemented.

resolution_trace.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 describes rules but not a standard evidence record showing which rules, modifiers, random terms, and state changes produced a result.
resolution_trace.g5_evidence: G5 emits a structured execution record linking action, procedure, target, die evidence, result/margin, and source authority.
resolution_trace.phase_a_evidence: Phase A adds modifier-by-modifier provenance, effective-target derivation trace, critical classification source trace, and generated-random seed/algorithm evidence.

replay_session_history.dodge_gap: DODGE 0.2.1 has no first-class immutable session/replay sequence comparable to the Wretched replay contract.
